scenario_description:
Objective: Reach Lahaina Community Center for the morning plankton-scope workshop using the paid Kahului shared shuttle already underway.
Emerging Need: The curb boarding and fare tap succeed, but that same shuttle ride then stops on the highway with the teaching cases onboard and no replacement assigned.
Decision Context: Workable recovery depends on combining the immobilized vehicle status with stored shuttle-rescue rules and the active booking reference before dispatch stops adding rescue riders.
Consequence: If the stalled ride is not helped during the rescue window, the same shuttle attempt can no longer deliver the cases before workshop setup.

parameter.title: Lahaina plankton-scope workshop setup
parameter.description: Bring plankton scope case and reef-current cards. Room opens at 09:00 for setup before the first group enters at 09:30.

parameter.subject: Kahului curb shuttle queued for Lahaina Community Center
parameter.body: The 07:40 shared shuttle from Kahului curb zone C is loading for Lahaina Community Center. Vehicle MG-14 is expected at the curb shortly; carry-on teaching cases may ride in the rear bay after fare validation.

parameter.description: Onboard fare tap for the Lahaina Community Center shared shuttle.

parameter.content: MG-14 departed Kahului curb with Keahi checked aboard. Tracker shows the next scheduled stop as Lahaina Community Center.

Trip status update: MG-14 is stopped on the Honoapiilani shoulder near mile marker 13 with a drivetrain lockout. The van cannot continue toward Lahaina; passengers and classroom cases remain onboard, and no replacement van is assigned in the tracker.

parameter.subject: Rescue van assignment window closed for MG-14
parameter.body: Central dispatch stopped adding stranded-rider rescue requests for the 07:40 Kahului-Lahaina run at 08:45 HST. Unlogged passengers from MG-14 must rebook later transportation from the shoulder; the paid shuttle transfer can no longer be protected for this run.
